sentence: This project develops fast exploration strategies based on approximate sampling for bandits and reinforcement learning problems.
This project creates hands-on learning modules about security weaknesses in the documents and source code used to deliver software.
This project studies fossil apes by excavating a Middle Miocene site and analyzing the fossils, rocks and past environment found there.
This project builds chatbots powered by large language models that talk with scammers to trace how social engineering attacks work.
This project upgrades instruments that record particle collisions and analyzes the data to test the Standard Model of particle physics.
This project surveys young stars with a robotic adaptive optics system to find planets and brown dwarfs far from their stars.
This project studies whether social robots can help people in a classroom develop classroom norms that are more inclusive.
This project investigates neurally inspired machines built from a network of single-electron quantum devices to solve optimization problems.
This project studies how plants and fungi that partner together affect each other's genes under different environmental conditions.
This project builds fast computer models that predict how sound waves travel through complex materials and update in real time from measurements.
This project builds a theory for synthetic data, which keeps the patterns of real data while protecting private information about people.
This project studies which genes help cyanobacteria grow in different conditions and uses that to forecast harmful algal blooms.
This project develops a robotic prosthesis for people with below-knee amputations that adjusts to each user's movement patterns.
This project studies how small desert rodents move across loose sand and builds models to help robots move on sand.
